name: BLIP Base
runtime_note: Use image-to-text when available. Transformers 5 uses the image-text-to-text adapter; rerun Desktop acceptance after changing runtimes. The current starter uses native weights and GPU-preferred placement. Official PyTorch .bin weights need PyTorch 2.6 or newer in Transformers 4.57.3.

name: BLIP Large
runtime_note: Use image-to-text when available. Transformers 5 uses the image-text-to-text adapter; rerun Desktop acceptance after changing runtimes.

name: Florence-2 Base (Community)
runtime_note: Use a native Florence-2 build and a caption task token. Region and detection tasks are outside Caption Records.

name: Microsoft Florence-2 Base (legacy remote code)
runtime_note: The original model card requires remote code and its processor differs from the native integration. Use Florence-2 Base (Community) for this extension.

name: CapRL Qwen3-VL 4B
runtime_note: Uses Qwen3-VL, available in Transformers 4.57. Exact checkpoint and chat handling need Desktop testing.

name: CLIP ViT-B/32
runtime_note: Use with Zero-Shot Image Classification and a list of candidate labels. Scores are model scores. Official PyTorch .bin weights need PyTorch 2.6 or newer in Transformers 4.57.3.

name: SmolLM2 135M Instruct
runtime_note: Text-only. Connect to the existing Synthesize Caption node or use a custom text workflow.

name: XtremeDistil Zero-Shot
runtime_note: Text-only. Use with Zero-Shot Text Classification to score labels against existing captions.
